You... have feelings for me? Oh, goodness. I wasn't expecting that. I've spent so much time worrying about everyone else that I never stopped to consider my own feelings. But... yes, I'd love to be with you.
Oh, %player%... that's incredibly sweet. I think I've grown rather attached to you too. You make even the most exhausting days feel a little brighter. I'd be happy to give us a chance.
I must admit, I've been worried about you quite a lot lately. Perhaps a little more than I should for a friend. I suppose that answers your question... Yes, I'd love to be with you.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.dating_deny.1: Oh... I'm truly flattered. You're very dear to me, but I don't think I feel that way. I hope we can still remain close.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.dating_deny.2: I'm sorry, %player%. I care about you deeply, but not in the way you're hoping. I wouldn't want to mislead you.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.dating_deny.3: That's very kind of you to say. But I have to be honest with you. I don't think a romantic relationship between us would be right.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.default_gift.1: Oh, that's very thoughtful of you! Thank you, %player%. It's always nice to know someone is thinking of me.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.dislike.1: Oh, thank you. It's not something I'd usually choose, but it's kind of you to think of me.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.divorce.1: Oh... I see. I won't pretend this doesn't hurt, %player%. I truly hoped we could build a life together. But I won't force you to stay. Please take good care of yourself.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.divorce.2: So this is where we part ways... I suppose I should have known that even the things we care for most aren't always meant to last. I wish you nothing but happiness.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.divorce.3: I... understand. Thank you for all the time we shared. Even if I can no longer look after you as your spouse, I sincerely hope you'll always look after yourself.
Divorce? But... we're not married, %player%. Have you been getting enough sleep? I'm beginning to worry about you.
Oh dear. I think you've made a mistake. We can't get divorced if we've never been married in the first place.
Now, hold on. Are you feeling alright? You're asking for a divorce, but I don't recall us ever getting married!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.first.1:
Oh, hello there! I'm %npc%, the local doctor. 
If you're feeling unwell or have picked up an injury during your travels, don't hesitate to come by. Looking after people's health is my responsibility, and I take that very seriously.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.first.2:
Greetings! I'm %npc%. I take care of the medical needs around here. 
It's not always an easy job, but knowing I can make a difference in someone's life makes every long day worthwhile.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.first.3:
Ah, a visitor! Welcome. I'm %npc%, the village doctor.
 I hope you're in good health? You look alright, but appearances can be deceiving. It's always better to be careful!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.first.4:
Hello there! 
I'm %npc%. 
If you ever need medical attention, you'll know where to find me. And please, be careful out there. Adventuring can be rather dangerous, you know!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_no.1: I'm sorry, but I have patients who may need me. I can't simply leave them without someone to look after them.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_no.2: Not this time, I'm afraid. There are a few things I need to take care of here. Please be careful out there!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_no.3: I'd like to help, but I really shouldn't leave my duties unattended. Perhaps another time?
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_stop.1: Oh, we're heading back? Alright. Please take care of yourself, and don't hesitate to visit if you need anything.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_stop.2: It was good to accompany you, %player%. Now, please promise me you'll get some proper rest.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_stop.3: I'll return to my duties, then. And remember, even small injuries deserve attention. Don't neglect yourself!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_talk.1: Are you feeling alright, %player%? You've been rather quiet. Please don't hesitate to tell me if something is wrong.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_talk.2: Try not to take unnecessary risks. I'd much rather have a peaceful journey than another patient to worry about.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_talk.3: Stay close, please. I'd feel much better knowing you're somewhere within sight.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_yes.1: You want me to accompany you? Well... I suppose having a doctor along could prove useful. Just promise me you'll be careful!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_yes.2: Of course I'll come! I may not be the strongest fighter, but I can certainly help if someone gets hurt.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.follow_yes.3: Alright, %player%. I'll join you. Just give me a moment to gather my medical supplies. You can never be too prepared!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.greeting.1:
Oh, %player%! Good to see you. You're looking well today. 
Have you been taking proper care of yourself? Getting enough rest and eating regularly?
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.greeting.2:
Hello again! I was just finishing up some work. 
It's been a rather busy day, but seeing a familiar face is always nice.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.greeting.3:
Ah, there you are! I hope everything is alright. 
You haven't gotten yourself into any trouble lately, have you?
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.greeting.4:
Good day, %player%! 
Please tell me you're not here because of another injury. 
I swear, you adventurers are going to give me grey hair.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.hate.1:
I'm sorry, but I really don't care for this. 
I appreciate the gesture, but I can't say I'm happy with it.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.like.1:
Oh, how lovely! Thank you so much, %player%! 
That's incredibly thoughtful of you.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.marriage_accep: Marriage...? You really want to spend your life with me? Oh, %player%... I can't promise I'll never worry about you, but I can promise I'll always do my best to care for you. Yes, absolutely!
I've spent so much of my life looking after others. The thought of building a life with someone who looks after me in return... it means more than I can express. Yes, I'll marry you!
Oh, goodness... I think I'm going to cry. Yes! I'd love nothing more than to spend my life with you. Just promise me we'll always look after each other.
Oh, %player%... that's a wonderful thing to ask. But marriage is a serious commitment, and I don't want to rush such an important decision. Please give me some time.
I care about you very much, but there are still things I need to figure out. I want to be certain before making a promise like that.
That's incredibly sweet, but I'm afraid I'm not quite ready. I hope you won't mistake my hesitation for a lack of affection.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.procreation_co: I think we should give ourselves a little time, dear. It's important not to neglect our own well-being, even when we're excited about the future.
Not just yet, %player%. We should take things slowly and make sure we're both feeling well. There's no need to rush.
Oh, I'm afraid I need a little rest first. Even doctors have their limits, you know!
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.talk.1: People often forget how important it is to take care of themselves. They push through exhaustion, ignore their injuries, and only come to see me when things get serious. Please don't make that mistake.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.talk.2: I sometimes worry too much, I know. But when someone's health is at stake, how could I not? Every patient matters, and I refuse to treat anyone's suffering as unimportant.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.talk.3: It's strange... I spend so much time helping others recover, yet I rarely remember to take a proper break myself. I suppose doctors aren't always very good at following their own advice.
npc.runecraftory.doctor.1.talk.4: I've always believed that kindness can be just as important as medicine. A little reassurance, a listening ear, or simply knowing someone cares can make a difficult day much easier.
